title: feat: LTB-local validation policy selector without production thresholds
intent: Represent, store, and select an owner-approved ValidationPolicyV1. Do not choose physical thresholds, and do not ship an active production policy.
behavior_change: A caller-supplied directory can store immutable policy JSON. select_validation_policy returns the existing ValidationPolicyV1 only for one approved active match. No route, no production threshold, and no manufacturing authority is added.

diff_articulation.what_changed: LTB-local policy record, canonical digest, exclusive JSON repository, and a selector that constructs ValidationPolicyV1 from one approved active record. The owner worksheet records that both numeric fields lack approval, so no production policy file is added. The proposal gate and beginner harness are unchanged.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The gate could only receive a test-constructed ValidationPolicyV1. A durable approval-bound record is required before a review route can select a policy, and this patch does not invent the physical limits.
